defs.def: to cause physical pain to sb/yourself; to injure sb/yourself （使）疼痛，受伤

ex.s: Having noticed this, Mia asked Ivy, “Did I hurt you?
ex.t: 注意到这一点后，米娅问艾薇："我伤害到你了吗？你看起来有点____不对劲。"艾薇犹豫了一下，然后承认了自己的感受。

ex.s: Every time I _____25_____ Jacky to something new, he’ll do it only because he trusts me and feels _____26_____ in the knowledge that he won’t get hurt ._____27_____ , teaching Jacky to swim means he has to _____28_____ that, when he’s swimming in the big pool, I’ll come to his rescue if his doggy paddle lets him down.
ex.t: 每次我_____25_____Jacky尝试新事物时，他这样做只是因为他信任我并且感到_____26_____确信他不会受伤。_____27_____，教Jacky游泳意味着他必须_____28____相信，当他在大泳池里游泳时，如果他的狗刨式划水不管用了，我会去救他。
海狸鼠伤害当地猫大小的动物。

ex.s: I couldn't quite believe my _____53_____ it turned out no one got badly hurt, but the outcome could have been _____54_____ .Don was given a special _____55_____ that night—I didn’t want him thinking I was angry with him.

ex.s: The spray burns the bears' eyes，but doesn't hurt them.
ex.t: 所以我慢慢靠近这位不速之客隔着围栏向它的脸上喷洒。

ex.s: It keeps the suspect from hurting others.
ex.t: 它使识别嫌疑人变得容易。
"她以为我受伤了____（我），"帕尔森说

ex.s: This is called “herd immunity”, which protects the people who get hurt easily, including those who can’t be vaccinated for medical reasons, babies too young to get vaccinated and people on whom the vaccine doesn’t work.
ex.t: 这被称为“群体免疫”，它保护那些容易受到伤害的人，包括因医疗原因无法接种疫苗的人、太小不能接种的婴儿，以及疫苗对其不起作用的人。

ex.s: As soon as they started to get closer, they hurt each other with their quills, so they had to move apart.
ex.t: 他们一靠近彼此，就被对方的刺扎伤，于是不得不分开。

ex.s: But the look on everybody’s face when you’re finished and packing, it’s the best smile in the world; and there’s nobody hurt, and the well’s under control.
ex.t: 但当你完成工作、收拾东西时，每个人脸上的表情是世界上最棒的笑容；没有人受伤，情况已得到控制。

ex.s: I fell against the wooden house and hurt my arm.
ex.t: 我撞在木屋上，伤了胳膊。

defs.def: to feel painful 感到疼痛

ex.s: “When your child says, ‘My stomach hurts,’ you can say, ‘Well you had a lot of sugary foods and you might feel better if you made some other choices,’” says Markey.
ex.t: 我们拥有的工具越多，我们就能变得更有效、更有洞察力。

ex.s: Treated this way, you’re sure to feel hurt - we should always be able to trust those closest to us, and it hurts even more when we find we can’t.
ex.t: 被这样对待，你肯定会感到受伤——我们应该始终能够信任最亲近的人，而当我们发现无法信任时，会更加痛苦。

ex.s: After repeating this process a few times, they eventually found the ideal distance where they could feel warm while managing not to hurt each other.
ex.t: 反复了几次这个过程后，他们最终找到了一个理想的间距，既能感到温暖，又不会互相伤害。

defs.def: to make sb unhappy or upset 使不快；使烦恼
to feel unhappy or upset 感到不高兴（或烦恼）
to have a bad effect on sb/sth 对 … 有不良影响
to be in a difficult situation because you need sth, especially money 处于困境；手头拮据

ex.s: By mile 17, I became out of breath and the once injured ankle hurt badly.
ex.t: 到第17英里时，我喘不过气来，曾经受伤的脚踝疼得厉害。

defs.def: upset and offended by sth that sb has said or done （感情上）受伤的

ex.s: "I just didn't want the boy to be hurt," said Henry.
ex.t: "我只是不想让那孩子受伤，"Henry说。
